person_note: The event quotations repeatedly render Joe’s private thoughts and beliefs through third-person base narration, while the authorized Chapter Two excerpt independently shows the same pattern. Whole-book explicit commentary identifies the novel as third-person omniscient, and a craft reference corroborates deep third person in the first two chapters. First-person forms in the quote set occur only in dialogue or universal maxims and are not competing narrative sections. The main limitation is that the authorized prose source covers one chapter, but the whole-book description and multiple diagnostic interior passages mitigate that scope limitation; no evidence of alternating or framed first-person narration was found.
